latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Voiceover Italiano — generate Italian voiceovers for uploaded videos.

- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Adds AI-generated Italian voiceovers to existing videos for content creators and marketers.
- Automatic backend setup and session management with free credits on first use.
- Fast cloud processing (1–2 minutes) with 1080p MP4 output.
- User commands recognized for uploading, exporting, checking status, and credits.
- Clear error handling and tips for supported formats and troubleshooting.
